meta.name: consistency-check
meta.description: Detect inconsistencies across related artefacts and governance constraints. Activate after story generation, after plan preparation, before implementation, or after remediation attempts. Reports issues — does not fix them.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 发现开发工件间的不一致并报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常因需求、计划或实现间矛盾而返工
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often face contradictions between stories, plans, and implementations

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 在检查项目文档（如故事、计划、PRD）和规则时，会发现其中的矛盾、遗漏或冲突，并生成一份问题报告。它只报告问题，不负责修复。
howto.when: 在故事生成之后、计划准备之后、实施之前、修复尝试之后，或进行治理审核时，该技能会自动激活。

say.text: 检查这个故事的规划是否与父史诗一致。
say.note: 触发跨工件一致性检查。

say.text: 帮我看看这份PRD有没有遗漏的验收标准。
验证当前计划是否包含超出范围的操作。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude detects inconsistencies across artefacts (epics, stories, plans, PRDs) and governance rules. It generates a report listing issues but does not fix them.
howto.when_en: Activated after story generation, after plan preparation, before implementation, after remediation attempts, or during governance gates.

say_en.text: Check if this story's plan aligns with its parent epic.
Review this PRD for missing acceptance criteria.
Verify the current plan has no out-of-scope actions.
